about: Generation briefs for the video editor's background-music library. Each brief is sent to AZ Studio as one Lyria 3.5 instrumental job (AZ Studio appends its own 'Instrumental only' instruction). These are generation inputs, not app data: the app reads the published tracks from Firestore `videoMusicTracks`.

shared.suffix: Mixed as background music for a spoken video: steady overall level, clear space in the mid range for a voice, no long silences, no fade-out lasting more than two seconds. Finish on a clean final chord or hit so the track can end a video. Instrumental only: no vocals, no humming, no choir, no spoken words, no chanting.

tracks.title: Rising Harmattan
tracks.style: Epic orchestral with deep ensemble drums
tracks.prompt: A 60-second epic cinematic orchestral cue in D minor at 100 BPM. Low strings pulse in eighth notes, deep ensemble drums and frame drums drive the rhythm, French horns state a bold four-note theme, and a dusty, windswept texture evokes a dry desert wind. Structure: [0:00 - 0:10] low string pulse and distant drums; [0:10 - 0:30] horns enter with the theme over full percussion; [0:30 - 0:50] full orchestra swells with soaring violins; [0:50 - 1:00] final triumphant hit and a short ring-out.

tracks.title: Dawn over the Savannah

Soft sustained strings open, a solo horn plays a broad lyrical melody, harp arpeggios sparkle, and the full brass section rises gradually with timpani rolls. Structure: [0:00 - 0:15] gentle strings and harp; [0:15 - 0:40] horn melody; [0:40 - 1:05] full orchestra rises to a warm climax; [1:05 - 1:15] calm resolution on a sustained major chord.

Structure: [0:00 - 0:12] pulsing synth and ticking percussion; [0:12 - 0:28] staccato strings and rising tension; [0:28 - 0:41] release into a bright, driving section; [0:41 - 0:45] one final hit.

tracks.title: Guardians of the Hills

Structure: [0:00 - 0:08] galloping strings and snare; [0:08 - 0:30] brass fanfare theme; [0:30 - 0:42] full orchestra with a key change upward; [0:42 - 0:45] final heroic chord.
tracks.revision: Rewritten 2026-09-27: earlier takes contained a human voice, so the brief now names only instruments.

Structure: [0:00 - 0:05] marimba and hand drums; [0:05 - 0:34] the full band; [0:34 - 0:40] a short breakdown and a final hit.
tracks.revision: Rewritten a third time 2026-09-28: takes in beat-making styles (afrobeats, EDM) carried imitation producer tags and DJ drops, so these briefs describe a live band recorded in a studio, the kind of recording that carries no tags.
